message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with the title "TEMPO" in large white capital letters at the top. Above it, a blue bar contains the text "Investigasi: Siapa Sesungguhnya Sutiyoso". Below the title is the text "EDISI: 9-15 September 2002". Centered in the middle is the headline "SENJA KALA AKBAR DI SENAYAN" in bold, black capital letters with white outlines.

The background is a landscape with a bright orange sky and a pale yellow circle resembling a sun or moon. Seven black birds fly across the sky. Below them, a large caricature of a man lies face down on a cracked, yellowish, rocky surface. The man wears a yellow jacket with a white shirt cuff visible at his left wrist, and greyish trousers. He has short brown hair, glasses, a large red nose, and his eyes are closed. His mouth is open in a grimace. His body is slumped over a jagged edge of the rocky ground. In the bottom-left corner is a barcode, and in the bottom-right corner, the price "Rp 14,700" is visible. Small, unclear red text sits at the bottom center.
